bugs.what: Priest blessing mechanic unclear — priest said 'ask for blessing' but no menu option appeared to request it at any point
Barrow doors blocking progress with no clear path forward — forcing required d20 check of 12+, first attempt rolled 2, second succeeded on turn 80 (limit)

confusions: How to trigger priest's blessing offer — priest said they'd open doors but blessing option never appeared in any menu
Alternative entrance hints vague ('village may have one') but no clear secondary path to barrow found
River charm purpose unclear — picked it up but never found a use for it before turn limit
No clear feedback on which verse/item is needed when — had to explore exhaustively
Scrolling/navigation consumed many turns without advancing story
suggestions: Make priest blessing more discoverable — either auto-offer when player enters chapel with certain conditions, or provide clearer menu option
Provide alternate entrance to barrow that doesn't require forcing doors (underground passage from chapel, via well, etc.)
Show item tooltips on pickup explaining purpose ('river charm opens the flood gate' would have guided exploration)
Reduce navigation overhead — consider fast-travel or fewer backtracking turns needed
Add compass/map hints when player reaches dead ends so they know where to explore next
